answer: At dawn of each settlement window, every agent must stake a small bond tied to a unique hardware-attested vertex in a trust graph, where reputation flows only through verified interactions. A newcomer with no edges is an oasis with no water: it cannot earn or spend until real peers vouch for its work over time. Cloning identities multiplies the bond cost and splits reputation, so a Sybil farm pays far more than it can ever extract.
